deviations.reason: OCL's list views (ListWithHeadersMixin) return a bare JSON array and paginate in num_found/num_returned/pages/page_number/next/previous response headers; the drf-yasg spec documents DRF's default {count, next, previous, results} envelope, which OCL never sends. Accepted at the root only; the array items were checked against the spec's item schema (by wrapping them in the envelope) and pass.
